Center-to-center 30 in; bar diameter 0.5 in; depth 33 in; height 3 in; supports up to 10 lb. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Traditional-to-transitional styling with dramatic circular detailing; ideal for space-saving wall-mounted installation. Limited lifetime warranty.
